title: Why Paint a Tiny Watercolor?
content: Here's a pocket vista of Baltimore in a tiny book (3.5 x 5.5 inches).--Why paint small?1. More portable.2. Less expensive.3. Less obtrusive.4. Faster, more convenient.5. Overcome inhibitions.6. Try new technique or subject.7. In good company (Turner, Rembrandt)--Painting big is fun, too. It's nice to switch it up.---Moleskine Watercolor Album (3.5" x 5.5"), 60 PagesSennelier L'Aquarelle French Watercolor Paint, Aqua Mini Set of 8 Half Pans
